- 🌐 用户态网络数据面：FD.io VPP 的 PPPoE 客户端插件与高性能路由器系统原型<br/>
  <sub>User-space dataplane: FD.io VPP PPPoE client plugin & VPP-based router prototypes</sub>

  <sub>macOS driver bring-up: native IO80211 MT792x Wi-Fi, ConnectX-3 Pro IOKit port & Zen 5 notes</sub>
